Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts`.

- Destination card click opens Prepare on that destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:493`) — The Prepare screen opens on the chosen destination. Once a copy exists the panel is replaced by the copies list. If it fails: The probe can be null (loading or error), so cards show "…" instead of a size. Navigation still works. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:149-151`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:489-505`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destinations-panel.tsx:78-83`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`.

If it fails: The IPC handler is fire-and-forget. If the thumbnail is missing, the drag silently does nothing (main/library/index.ts:167-168). The handler logs other errors via console.error. The user sees no erro… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:164-180`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:231-236`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/library/index.ts:161-175`.

If it fails: The dimensions are computed rather than measured. A copy made by an older version of the sizing rules would show today's dimensions. No error is shown. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:104-114`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:433-447`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:478-486`.

Nothing is shown to the user and the drag just does not start.… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:164-180`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/library/index.ts:161-175`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/preload/index.ts:87`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:235`.

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** I found three minor issues in this part and nothing that blocks the merge. Two are test problems: the drag test overwrites the shared `startFileDrag` stub and never restores it, and the "Open in Export" test never checks the case where the button is absent. The third is that the destination cards show "…" for their sizes forever if the file cannot be probed. The new drag handle matches the existing status-card drag. Destination clicks go through the same `openPrepare` path as the old chips and the post-recording card. The probe-derived picture sizes match what the presets produce. I read only this part's files plus the callers and helpers they use; the CSS, docs and i18n files belong to the other part.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I read all nine files of this part and found no defects. The two findings are both at \"consider\": a stale heading name in the doc, and a missing test for a heavy master that already has copies.

- **Messages and CSS:** the en/es message keys match. The removed `where*` and `copiesEmpty` keys have no other users, and `sendTo` is still used by the Library card and row. Every CSS custom property the new stylesheets use is defined in `packages/tokens/css/tokens.css` or `base.css`. Nothing still references the deleted strip.
- **Docs:** the doc's claims about the page match the code, including `DESTINATION_IDS` (six destinations), the probe now running for every local recording, and the Drag IPC. The one stale spot is the old \"Copies from this master\" heading in \"How it works\".
- **Tests:** the test file's assertions match the components. The new `getByRole(\"status\")` has no competing `role=\"status\"` element on this page. Heavy-master-with-copies has no coverage.
- **Open contract:** the page now reads the file for every local recording, and I did not read `useSourceProbe`'s rejection handling, which is in another part. If the read fails, the destination cards may sit on \"…\" with no error shown. That entry is left open.

</details>
